bugClass: comparison on wrong variable (sign decided from per-item value instead of total) -> conservation/sign violation
bugSummary: distribute() decided the direction of the leftover-penny adjustment from the per-item value (which is 0 for the leftover parts) instead of the sign of the total intValue, so distributing a small negative amount produced positive parts (wrong sign, sum != amount).
triggerInput: currency(-0.01).distribute(5) must be [-0.01,0,0,0,0] (sum -0.01); buggy returns [0.01,0,0,0,0] (sum +0.01). Also currency(-0.03).distribute(4): correct sum -0.03, buggy sum +0.03.
